title: FF7 Front Load Washer
sub: Matte black, 3.5 cu. ft., door hinged on the left
lead: Speed Queen's front load washer, in matte black, with the door hinged on the left. Eleven cycles, a stainless steel tub inside a stainless steel outer tub, a 1,200 rpm spin, and Pet Plus cycles that include one for fleas. Backed for five years, parts and labor.

features.name: Pet Plus, with a Flea cycle
features.line: Cycles made for pet bedding and blankets, and a Flea cycle that Speed Queen says it designed and tested for flea infestations.

features.name: Sanitize with Oxi
features.line: A sanitizing cycle that works with an Oxi laundry additive, for bedding, towels and the loads that need more than clean.

features.name: Eleven cycles, fine control
features.line: Bedding and Tub Clean among eleven preset cycles, with four temperatures, four soil levels, four spin speeds and up to three extra rinses. Stain Boost takes on cold- and warm-water stains.

features.name: Dynamic Balancing, 1,200 rpm
features.line: A variable-speed 1 HP motor spins up to 1,200 rpm, and Speed Queen's Dynamic Balancing keeps a heavy load in line while it does.

features.name: Five years, parts and labor
features.line: Speed Queen backs the FF7 with a 5-year warranty that covers parts and labor.

also: Stainless steel wash tub and outer tub
Also made with the door hinged on the right (FF7012)
A matching 8-inch riser pedestal is made for it, sold separately
